message:
Fixed: "Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes (3 of 3).

The cause was the vendored `slugify`, which deletes every character outside `a-z0-9`, accented letters included. That file says not to edit it by hand, so I left it alone. The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now strips accent marks from the title before passing it to `slugify`.

`src/shop/product-url.js` calls the same vendored function, so shop product URLs still drop accented letters. I didn't change it because you only asked about blog posts. It would take the same one-line change if you want it.
